summary: First-run full-stack testing for TheShutki.com. Ran 36 pytest backend API tests (100% pass) covering auth, products, categories, coupons, orders (COD+UPI+QR), reviews, settings, admin analytics/inventory/customers/CRUD. Executed Playwright end-to-end: Home -> Search(Nethili) -> Product -> Variant 500g -> Add to Cart -> Pincode check -> Cart -> Apply FIRST10 (total correctly discounted) -> Checkout (COD) -> Order placed (TS2610065F275, redirected to /order-confirmation). Admin login works at /account; /admin dashboard renders analytics (Revenue, Orders, AOV, Customers, Sales chart, Bestsellers, Inventory alerts); admin-nav-products works and add-product-btn present. All critical flows PASS.

minor.issue: server.py has allow_origins=['*'] combined with allow_credentials=True. Browsers reject credentialed requests under wildcard origin. Bearer-token flow still works, but httpOnly cookie fallback will fail cross-origin. Set explicit origins or disable allow_credentials.

Server does NOT recompute item prices from DB — trusts client-sent 'price' per line item. A malicious client can set price=0 and place a free order. Validate against product.variants.price server-side.
No auth required to place order; also decrements stock before payment confirmation (even for UPI). Consider requiring auth and only decrementing on payment success.
Public — anyone with an order_id can fetch full customer address/phone. Should require owner or admin.
References undefined 'backend' variable in local scope but doesn't use it (dead code); also no file-size/type validation.

issues: After admin login the page stays on /account (toast only); user has to manually navigate to /admin. Consider auto-redirect to /admin for role=admin.

action_items: Fix CORS: set explicit origins when allow_credentials=True (don't use '*').
Harden POST /api/orders: validate item prices against DB; require auth for order creation; only decrement stock on paid.
(UX) Auto-redirect admin users to /admin after login from /account.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 998 lines in a single file — split into routers/models/services for maintainability.
Order totals are recomputed server-side for subtotal and shipping but item prices are trusted from client input — price tampering vulnerability.
CORS allow_credentials=True with allow_origins=['*'] is spec-invalid; browsers will block credentialed cross-origin requests.
Stock decrement happens before payment confirmation (even for UPI orders where no gateway capture occurs) — risk of stock drain by abandoned orders.
GET /api/orders/{order_id} is unauthenticated and leaks PII (name/phone/address).
Minor: /api/upload has unused 'backend' env lookup and no size/MIME validation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows (search, PDP, cart, coupon, COD checkout, admin dashboard)

All data-testids are discoverable in Header.js, Cart.js, Checkout.js, ProductDetail.js, Shop.js. UPI order QR verified in backend test test_place_upi_order_returns_qr. Order placement does NOT require auth. Admin redirect: after login at /account it stays on /account; navigate to /admin manually.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking issues. Only hardening recommendations (security-of-order endpoint, price tampering, CORS).
